record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.original_question: Let M be a globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter manifold with particles of cone angle less than π. Does M admit a unique constant-mean-curvature time function whose level surfaces are all orthogonal to the singularities?

evidence.quote: Question 6.4. Does M admit a unique CMC time with each surface of constant time orthogonal to the singularities?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a three-dimensional globally hyperbolic maximal anti-de Sitter spacetime with particles, where particles are cone singularities along time-like geodesic lines with cone angles strictly less than $\pi$, and the Cauchy surfaces of $M$ are closed orientable surfaces (with marked points where particles cross them). A constant-mean-curvature (CMC) time function on $M$ is a smooth function $\tau: M \to \mathbb{R}$ such that for each value $t$ in its range, the level set $\tau^{-1}(t)$ is a space-like Cauchy surface of constant mean curvature $t$.

Prove or disprove: Every such $M$ admits a unique CMC time function whose level surfaces are everywhere orthogonal to the particle (singular) lines.
artifact.category_tag: Anti-de Sitter geometry with cone singularities
artifact.status_search_result: A 2017 paper (Chen–Tamburelli, "Constant mean curvature foliation of globally hyperbolic (2+1)-spacetimes with particles," arXiv:1705.03674, published in Geometriae Dedicata 2019) establishes existence and uniqueness of a CMC foliation for globally hyperbolic (2+1)-spacetimes with particles having cone angles less than π, extending the classical smooth result to the singular AdS setting. This affirmatively resolves the question.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature foliation of globally hyperbolic (2+1)-spacetimes with particles
status_evidence.snippet: It is well known that M admits a unique foliation by constant mean curvature surfaces. In this paper we extend this result to singular spacetimes with particles (cone singularities of angles less than π along time-like geodesics).
status_evidence.claim: Existence and uniqueness of CMC foliation extends to globally hyperbolic AdS spacetimes with particles of cone angle less than π.

status_evidence.title: Maximal surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds with particles
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of a unique maximal surface in each anti-de Sitter GHM manifold with particles (with conical singularities along time-like lines) for cone angles less than π.
status_evidence.claim: Related uniqueness result for the maximal (mean curvature zero) surface in the same setting.
